name: Valley Hunters
summary:
Valley Hunters is a free-to-play fantasy MMORPG played directly in the web browser on PC, tablet and mobile, with nothing to download or install. Players start in a village in the middle of the Valley of Rifts and choose one of three classes – Warrior, Mage or Assassin – each with four skills of its own, plus attribute points and a shared talent tree with four branches. Gear of different rarities can be found, bought, crafted and upgraded.

Players can form parties of up to five with evenly split kill rewards, join or found guilds and trade with each other. The game features dungeons, world bosses and Nightmares, a single-player mode of procedurally generated floors with a new curse each week and a leaderboard. Each account also has a homestead shared by all of its characters, along with daily and weekly quests, achievements and titles.
